free_tier_limits: Free public API; no paid plans. Exact numeric quotas not cleanly published as fixed ~100 unauth / higher auth figures; use response rate-limit headers and current docs/community guidance.
rate_limits: Official docs emphasize checking rate-limit response headers; authenticated JWT access gets higher limits than unauthenticated. Community figures (~100/min unauth, ~1000/min auth) are not authoritative fixed published quotas.
resolution_notes: auth_type: keep jwt — official self-serve token page and API use a JWT API token (Authorization: Bearer or JWT), not a classic opaque API key; directory enum has jwt which matches. free_tier_limits: Verifier B correct — no fixed published free-tier numeric quotas; rewrote conservatively. rate_limits: Verifier B correct — do not ship ~100/~1000 as established published limits; headers + auth higher. Evidence: https://api.inaturalist.org/v1/docs/ , https://www.inaturalist.org/users/api_token , https://www.inaturalist.org/pages/api+reference , https://forum.inaturalist.org/
